connector.name: Vaara MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Accountable autonomy MCP server: gating, tamper-evident audit for every action
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package vaara. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vaaraio account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: VAARA_DB
env.description: Path to the SQLite audit DB. Defaults to vaara_audit.db in the working directory.

env.name: VAARA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional shared secret. When set, every tool call must include _api_key in its arguments. Leave unset for single-tenant stdio deployments where process isolation is enough.
